csv_project_name: Design for 227th Ave NW - Ambassador Blvd NW Reconstruction
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Minnesota, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide design services for SP 0206-91 TH47 St Francis reconstruct project is the reconstruction of TH47 from approximately Cree St to Ambassador Blvd in the City of St Francis. Work will include roundabouts at 227th, Pederson Dr, 233rd Ave, and Ambassador Blvd. There will also be trail/sidewalk/ADA improvements, and drainage improvements. The roadway will be converted to a 4-lane divided highway, to a 2-lane divided highway with a raised center median. Preliminary engineering for the project is currently led by the City of St Francis with a consultant team that will deliver a staff approved layout and approved programmatic categorical exclusion environmental document. Some coordination between the final design team and the preliminary design team may be required. Utility identification and coordination will also be required on this project.
